"import cadquery as cq

# Hard-coded parameters (mm)
seg1_radius = 25.0
seg1_z_start = 0.0
seg1_z_end = 35.0

seg2_radius = 18.0
seg2_z_start = 35.0
seg2_z_end = 65.0

seg3_radius = 11.0
seg3_z_start = 65.0
seg3_z_end = 87.0

bore_radius = 5.0

# Build the three coaxial cylindrical segments on the Z axis
seg1 = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(seg1_radius).extrude(seg1_z_end - seg1_z_start)
seg2 = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=seg2_z_start).circle(seg2_radius).extrude(seg2_z_end - seg2_z_start)
seg3 = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=seg3_z_start).circle(seg3_radius).extrude(seg3_z_end - seg3_z_start)

# Union the three segments into a single stepped solid
shaft = seg1.union(seg2).union(seg3)

# Cut the central through bore along the full length
bore = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(bore_radius).extrude(seg3_z_end)
final = shaft.cut(bore)

# Export the final single solid as a STEP file
cq.exporters.export(final.val(), "part.step")"
